# Jeremiah 21 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 21:14 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-punish-you according-to-the-fruit-of your-deeds," declares YHWH, "and-I-will-kindle a-fire in-her-forest, and-it-will-devour everything around-her." |
| LOGOS | I will punish you according to the fruit of your deeds, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her." |
| PNEUMA | But I will punish you for the consequences of what you've done," says the LORD. "I will set fire to your forests, and it will burn up everything around you." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 21:12 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | O-house-of David, thus says YHWH: "Judge with-justice in-the-morning, and-deliver [the]-robbed from-[the]-hand-of [the]-oppressor, lest My-fury go-forth like-fire and-burn and-none can-extinguish-[it], because-of the-evil-of your-deeds. |
| LOGOS | O house of David! Thus says the LORD: Execute justice in the morning, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed, lest My wrath go forth like fire, and burn with none to quench it, because of your evil deeds.' |
| PNEUMA | Family of David, this is what the LORD says: Give justice to the people every morning! Rescue victims from their oppressors — or else My anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all the evil you've done. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | Behold-Me against-you, [O]-inhabitant-of the-valley, rock-of the-plain," declares YHWH, "[you]-who-say, 'Who will-come-down against-us? And-who will-enter into-our-dwellings?' |
| LOGOS | "Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, O rock of the plain, declares the LORD; you who say, 'Who shall come down against us, or who shall enter our habitations?' |
| PNEUMA | "I am against you, Jerusalem, you who sit in the valley on the rocky plateau," declares the LORD. "You think, 'No one can attack us here! No one can break through our defenses!' |

## 21:7 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-afterward,' declares YHWH, 'I-will-give Zedekiah king-of Judah and-his-servants and-the-people and-those-remaining in this city from the-pestilence, from the-sword, and-from the-famine, into-the-hand-of Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon and-into-the-hand-of their-enemies and-into-the-hand-of those-seeking their-life, and-he-will-strike-them with-the-edge-of the-sword; he-will-not-spare-them and-will-not-have-pity and-will-not-have-compassion.' |
| LOGOS | Afterward, declares the LORD, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people in this city who survive the pestilence, sword, and famine into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of their enemies, into the hand of those who seek their lives. He shall strike them down with the edge of the sword. He shall not pity them or spare them or have compassion. |
| PNEUMA | Then, says the LORD, I will hand over King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone who survives the plague, war, and famine to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and to their enemies who want them dead. He will slaughter them without mercy, without pity, without compassion. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
